final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, risk_margin_records, 1.0 * risk_margin_records / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, risk_margin_records, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan
